posts.community: Interarch: A Proxy Play on India's Infrastructure and CapEx Revival
posts.text: Overall though PEB seems exciting, by the sheer capital intesive nature of it and some decent competition, I am not sure whether market would re-rate P/E much above 35 and hence generating alpha over a good Small Cap MF seems difficuilt as per my analysis so far…
